caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved dress rendered primarily in light pencil with areas of pale tan shading. The dress features a front center panel and a hem border of a diamond lattice pattern, filled in with the tan color, as well as matching decorative bands at the sleeve cuffs and around the hem. A large bow is drawn at the lower back of the dress, also accented with the same pattern. The garment includes a series of small buttons running down the center of the back. Below the dress are technical sketches: on the left, a close-up of the cuff’s lace or embroidery detail, and to its right, a vertical line, and a geometric grid or pattern draft comprised of triangles and diagonal lines. The bottom right corner contains the handwritten name "Gladys C. Parker." The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color.
title: Child's Dress
